name: hypercurl
description: Hyperliquid API requests grouped by network. Select Mainnet or Testnet before choosing an HTTP endpoint or WebSocket subscription. Local node contains operator-only queries.

items.name: meta
items.description:
Looks up mainnetHcCoin in the perpetuals market directory and checks its quantity precision (szDecimals). Open Visualize to see the result. Leave mainnetHcDex empty to use the default perpetuals DEX.

Reference: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/for-developers/api/info-endpoint/perpetuals#retrieve-perpetuals-metadata-universe-and-margin-tables

items.name: spotMeta

Looks up mainnetHcSpotPair in the spot market directory. The test matches the pair's first token index against tokens[].index to find the base token's szDecimals. Open Visualize to compare the base and quote token precisions.
